title: Eight maritime paintings for the second film cut
generator: OpenAI ImageGen, eight independent text-to-image generations
origin: Each painting is an original interpretation for Until We Return. The generating prompts follow the existing schooner, shore, harbour and crew art in the game. Local references were inspected visually before writing the prompts. No outside image or copyrighted film frame was used.
format: Each RGB source measured 1672 × 941. A centred, subpixel 16:9 crop and Lanczos resampling produced 1600 × 900 RGB WebP masters at quality 92. Each master is a complete individual painting.
coordinates: Normalised (x,y) from the upper-left corner of the final master. The water polygon marks one unobstructed patch, not the full water mask.

paintings.lock: Gunwale and distant headland stay locked. A sounding lead falls vertically, under tension from the lower hand.

paintings.lock: The rolled sail belongs to both sets of hands. Do not translate the ground, people’s planted boots or shore rocks with the surf.

paintings.lock: The three men, hull, mast and sail share one waterline. Shore rocks, tussock and headlands stay fixed.
